content_blocks.label: clause_1._Notice_of_Non-Payment
content_blocks.text: Tenant is hereby notified that he has failed to pay the rent due on September 1, 2024, and as of October 17, 2024, remains in arrears for a total of $1,200.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Deadline
content_blocks.text: Tenant is given thirty (30) days from the date of this notice to either cure the default by paying the outstanding rent or vacate the premises.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Consequences_of_Failure_to_Comply
content_blocks.text: If Tenant fails to comply with the terms of this notice, Landlord reserves the right to commence legal proceedings for eviction.
